title: Hybrid Work and Job–Home Networks in Spain
subtitle: Interactive intensity-gradient network atlas · 2022–2024
description: Explore Spain's job–home networks across six workplace-attendance recurrence layers. Directed flows show residential-to-employment connections, while district colours can display hybrid-work intensity, network outcomes, settlement context, and mapped conditional intensity relationships.

methodNote: Directed OD curves use non-self residential-to-employment job–home relations. For each recurrence layer, the public build retains the strongest 50,000 browser candidates from the complete positive network and reports their exact flow-mass coverage. District-level values are taken directly from Notebook 02 exports. Conditional intensity relationships are descriptive model outputs and are not presented as causal effects.
